		<description>At 21:02 on November 14, 2026, the Qiantang District Meteorological Observatory in Hangzhou issued a yellow warning signal for heavy fog: it is expected that from tonight to tomorrow morning, most streets in our district, such as Hezhuang, Yipeng, Xinwan, Linjiang, and Qianjin, will experience heavy fog with visibility less than 500 meters. Relevant units and personnel are requested to be prepared for prevention. Drivers should pay attention to changes in heavy fog, drive carefully, and pay attention to traffic safety.</description>
